_readme: Central model configuration. Edit THIS file to change model names.
Precedence (lowest -> highest): code defaults < this file < environment variables < database settings table.
After editing, either restart the app, or run:  python cli.py sync-model-config
That command pushes these values into the database settings table so they win over stale DB rows.
Groq does not expose an embeddings endpoint, so semantic search uses a local
ONNX model by default (no API key, runs on CPU, 384 dimensions).
Changing provider or model changes the vector dimension -> run: python cli.py reindex-vectors --force
auto  = PDF text layer first, then vision model, then Tesseract
vision= force the vision model (falls back to Tesseract on hard failure)
tesseract = classic local OCR only, never calls the vision model
reasoning_effort applies to reasoning-capable models such as openai/gpt-oss-120b.
Allowed: 'none' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Use 'none' to disable the parameter.
Reasoning tokens are billed against max_tokens_*, so values below ~512 can
return an empty response. A floor of 512 is enforced in code.
IMPORTANT: Groq counts (prompt + max_tokens) against the per-minute token
limit. The vision model's free-tier TPM is 8000, so max_tokens_vision must
stay small - 8192 made every vision request fail with HTTP 413.
